text:
Aisha (AE): Hey team — MeridianHealth dropped an RFP. They want a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers (cloud and on-prem), and a proposed POC plan + timeline. Need to turn around draft by EOD Friday.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Put me on the matrix. Quick Q: do they require HSM for keys or is KMS with BYOK okay?
Aisha (AE): They flagged HSM for PHI in a note, but said proposals for KMS/HSM both acceptable if controls match.
Devon (Infra Eng): For on‑prem option we should list supported quantizations and expected throughput on 4xA10G vs 8xH100. I can draft numbers but need the model family they want to test.
Aisha (AE): Meridian wants a gpt‑like instruction model + embeddings for search ranking. I'll share the sample prompt set shortly.
Tess (Security): I'll take the security questionnaire. Heads up: they asked about data residency, key lifecycle, and audit log retention to 7 years. We support VPC + Private deployment + audit logs, but 7 years retention is an add‑on.
Ben (Solutions Eng): For the capability matrix, let's include explicit rows: model catalog parity, streaming, token billing details, batching, cache behavior, identical API surface across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, and fallbacks.
Devon (Infra Eng): Note on fallbacks: we can route to a quantized cheaper variant automatically. I'll write a short note about latency tradeoffs: e.g., 8k context, 4xA10G continuous batching -> 35–60ms token p95 (depends on batch), 8xH100 -> 12–25ms p95.
Aisha (AE): Perfect. Ben, can you mock up a one‑page capability comparison vs two named competitors? They asked for a short competitive summary. Keep it high level.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Yep. I'll do a three‑column matrix: Feature / Redwood / Competitor A / Competitor B. Will call out unified runtime, rollout controls, and cost levers.
Tess (Security): Action for me: fill questionnaire answers for sections: encryption at rest, key management (BYOK/HSM), network isolation, vulnerability scanning, pen test cadence, SOC/FedRAMP posture, and incident response SLA.
Rachel (Legal): I'll prep a minimal SOW draft and check our standard addendum for extended log retention and FedRAMP representation. Also need to confirm NDA is signed before sharing raw prompt sets.
Aisha (AE): Meridian said they already signed the NDA but please confirm with procurement.
DeployBot: Aisha uploaded: /files/meridian/prompt_set_v1.csv and /files/meridian/security_q_2026.xlsx
Ben (Solutions Eng): Got the prompts. For the POC plan: propose a 4‑week timeline: week 0 agree success criteria + env, week 1 infra + mirror data (synthetic), week 2 tuning/latency tests, week 3 UAT and quality evals. Cost estimate attached in a gist.
Devon (Infra Eng): For the synthetic mirror, recommend using minimal PHI strip and run in their VPC via Private deployment — or we can run Dedicated with contract isolation. Need to flag egress costs.
Tess (Security): Two asks from security Q I flagged: 1) Provide certificate of encryption key rotation policy and 2) Clarify who holds root HSM keys for BYOK scenarios. We should include template language.
Rachel (Legal): I'll attach the standard BYOK clause and a short note on key custody options.
Aisha (AE): Ok owners: Ben = capability matrix + competitor summary + POC timeline; Devon = perf/latency numbers + deployment options + egress note; Tess = security questionnaire answers + templates; Rachel = SOW + BYOK clause.
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll drop a draft matrix in the thread by tomorrow morning.
Devon (Infra Eng): ETA for perf numbers and config snippets: 6 hours. Sample snippet I will include: ```
# example runtime config
model: rdx‑instruct‑v1
deployment: private
gpus: 4xA10G
quantization: int8
batching: adaptive
```
Tess (Security): I'll flag where we need customer evidence (e.g., SOC report). If they require FedRAMP Moderate, we'll note that as an ongoing work item — we don't claim FedRAMP yet.
Aisha (AE): Noted. I'll also ask Meridian to prioritize the 3 top success metrics for the POC (latency, cost per 1k tokens, and relevance at N=5).
Rachel (Legal): One more — procurement asked about liability cap and data breach notification timelines. I'll confirm draft limits.
Aisha (AE): Thanks everyone. If we can get the draft bundle (matrix, security answers, SOW, and POC timeline) in a single zip by EOD Friday, I'll send it to Meridian's procurement.
Ben (Solutions Eng): On it. :thumbsup:
Devon (Infra Eng): Will upload perf log snippets and a small sample benchmark CSV.
Tess (Security): Starting questionnaire now.
Rachel (Legal): I'll ping procurement for NDA confirmation and share SOW draft when ready.
Aisha (AE): Great — keeping this thread as the source of truth. Ping me for blocks.
